## trait data
```{r}
#| label: fig-qsfp
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-height: 6.5
#| fig-cap: Trait space quality according to the number of principal coordinate dimensions based on the absule deviance of euclidean distances.

traits <- read.csv("data/traits_v2.csv", header = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(sp = case_match(sp,
    "Bacillaria paradoxa" ~ "Bacillaria paxillifera",
    "Licmophora cf. flavellata" ~ "Licmophora cf. flabellata",
    "Campilodiscus sp." ~ "Campylodiscus sp.",
    "Achnantes sp." ~ "Achnanthes sp.",
    "Nitzschioides" ~ "Bacillariaceae",
    "Licmophora cf. flavellata" ~ "Licmophora cf. flabellata",
    "Nitzschia sp." ~ "Nitzschia sp.1",
    "Agregats Nitzschia sp." ~ "Nitzschia sp.2",
    "Entomoneis sp." ~ "Entomoneis sp.1",
    "Entomoneis sp. (petite)" ~ "Entomoneis sp.2",
    "Amphora sp." ~ "Amphora sp.1",
    "Amphora sp. (petite)" ~ "Amphora sp.2",
    "Synedra sp. (courbe)" ~"Synedra sp.",
    "Melosira moniliformis (chaine)" ~ "Melosira moniliformis",
    "Paralia sulcata (chaînes)" ~ "Paralia sulcata",
    "Diatomee pennee 100 µm" ~ "Haslea spp.",
    "Haslea sp." ~ "Haslea spp.",
    "Naviculoides" ~ "Naviculaceae",
    "Diatomees en gelee" ~ "Bacillariophyta",
    "Rhoicosphaenia sp." ~ "Rhoicosphenia sp.",
    "Toxarium hennedianum" ~ "Toxarium hennedyanum",
    .default = sp)
    )  %>% 
  group_by(sp) %>% 
  summarise(across(everything(), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
  filter(!sp %in% c("Bacillariophyta", "Nitzschia sp.2")) %>% 
  arrange(sp) %>% 
  select(-ellipsoid) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("sp")


quantile(traits$bv)

all_fuzzy <- traits %>% 
  mutate(bv_5 = as.integer(if_else(bv < 3000, 4, 0)),
         bv_5_10 = as.integer(if_else(bv < 15000 & bv >= 3000, 4, 0)),
         bv_10_20 = as.integer(if_else(bv >= 15000, 4, 0))) %>%
  select(-bv)
```

## assemblage data
```{r}
mpbc_raw <- read.csv("data/mpb_counts.csv", header = TRUE, row.names = 1 ) 

mpbc_homo <- mpbc_raw %>% 
  rownames_to_column("sp") %>% 
  mutate(sp = case_match(sp,
    "Bacillaria paradoxa" ~ "Bacillaria paxillifera",
    "Licmophora cf. flavellata" ~ "Licmophora cf. flabellata",
    "Campilodiscus sp." ~ "Campylodiscus sp.",
    "Achnantes sp." ~ "Achnanthes sp.",
    "Nitzschioides" ~ "Bacillariaceae",
    "Licmophora cf. flavellata" ~ "Licmophora cf. flabellata",
    "Nitzschia sp." ~ "Nitzschia sp.1",
    "Agregats Nitzschia sp." ~ "Nitzschia sp.2",
    "Entomoneis sp." ~ "Entomoneis sp.1",
    "Entomoneis sp. (petite)" ~ "Entomoneis sp.2",
    "Amphora sp." ~ "Amphora sp.1",
    "Amphora sp. (petite)" ~ "Amphora sp.2",
    "Synedra sp. (courbe)" ~"Synedra sp.",
    "Melosira moniliformis (chaine)" ~ "Melosira moniliformis",
    "Paralia sulcata (chaînes)" ~ "Paralia sulcata",
    "Diatomee pennee 100 µm" ~ "Haslea spp.",
    "Haslea sp." ~ "Haslea spp.",
    "Naviculoides" ~ "Naviculaceae",
    "Diatomees en gelee" ~ "Bacillariophyta",
    "Rhoicosphaenia sp." ~ "Rhoicosphenia sp.",
    "Toxarium hennedianum" ~ "Toxarium hennedyanum",
    .default = sp)
    )  %>% 
  group_by(sp) %>% 
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
  filter(!sp %in% c("Bacillariophyta", "Nitzschia sp.2")) %>% 
  arrange(sp)
  

mpbc <- as.data.frame(t(mpbc_homo %>% column_to_rownames("sp")))
mpbc[is.na(mpbc)] <-0

surf <- (pi*(2.7^2))*10^-4 #m2
vtot <- 0.1 #Litres
vsub <- 0.003 #Litres
mpbc_m2 <- mpbc %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = everything(), .fns = ~ .x * (vtot/vsub) * 1/surf))

mpbc_site <- mpbc_m2 %>%
  rownames_to_column("code") %>%
  mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1),
         site = case_when(site== "L" ~ "Pristine",
                           site == "R" ~ "Dredged"),
         month = as.numeric(str_sub(code,5, 6)),
         season = as.factor(case_when(month < 04 ~ "Winter",
                                      month >= 04 & month < 07 ~ "Spring",
                                      month >= 07 & month < 09 ~ "Summer",
                                      .default = "Autumn")),
         season = factor(season,
                         levels = c("Winter",
                                    "Spring", 
                                    "Summer",
                                    "Autumn"))) |> 
  select(site, month, season, code) |>
  column_to_rownames("code") 
  
```

### CWM
```{r}
#| include: false
# Recode the matrix to give the same weights to all traits 
#----------------------------------------------------------

# Create the function to convert the fuzzy coded matrix (going from 0 to 4 for each modality) to a relative coding in which all modality of a given trait sum to 1 for each species
transfo_traits <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(sum(x))) { # If we have NA's, gives back NA's
    rep(NA, length(x))
  } else if (sum(x) == 0) { #  If we have only 0's, gives back only 0's
    numeric(length(x))
  } else { # Else, we get the modality's score and divide it by the sum of the scores of the species for all modalities of this trait
    x / sum(x)
  }
}

trait_list <- data.frame(modality= colnames(all_fuzzy)) %>% 
  mutate(trait = c(
    rep("shape", 7), #shape
    rep("living habit", 5), #living habit
    rep("sociability", 6), #sociability
    rep("raphe", 3), #raphe
    rep("attachment", 4),
    rep("biovolume", 3)#attachment
  ))
  

# Prepare the trait list to apply the function
trait_list <- trait_list %>%
  # Reorder the list according to the order of the modalities in trait_fuz
  slice(match(colnames(all_fuzzy), trait_list$modality)) %>%
  # Reorder the trait factor levels
  mutate(trait = factor(trait, levels=unique(trait))) %>%
  droplevels()

# Compute the number of traits
n_trait <- nlevels(trait_list$trait)

# Define the start and end point of each trait
n_mod <- trait_list %>%
  # For that we compute the number of modalities for each trait
  group_by(trait) %>%
  summarise(n=n()) %>%
  pull(n) %>%
  # And we do the cumulative sum
  cumsum(.) %>%
  c(0,.)

# Apply the function
trait_prop <- all_fuzzy 
fuzzy_only <- all_fuzzy 
trait_prop[,] <- NA

for(i in 1:n_trait){
  # Select all the modalities of the trait i
  tmp <- fuzzy_only[,seq(from=n_mod[i]+1, to=n_mod[i+1], by=1)]
  # Apply the function to this trait
  tmp <- t(apply(tmp, 1, transfo_traits))
  tmp <- as.data.frame(tmp)
  # Save
  trait_prop[,seq(from=n_mod[i]+1, to=n_mod[i+1], by=1)] <- tmp
}



summary(trait_prop) %>%
  kableExtra::kable("html") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = F, position="left") %>%
  kableExtra::column_spec(column = n_mod+1, border_right = TRUE, include_thead = TRUE)



# com_trait <- as.matrix(mpbc_m2) %*% as.matrix(trait_prop)


# Compute CWM (we need to tell functcomp that trait_prop should considered as numerical) 
CWM_tot <- FD::functcomp(x=trait_prop,
                         a=as.matrix(mpbc_m2),
                         bin.num=c("cylinder",
                                   "cymbelloid",
                                   "gomphonemoid",
                                   "prism.on.triangular.base",
                                   # "epipsammic",
                                   # "epilithic",
                                   "zigzag",
                                   "araphid",
                                   "biraphid",
                                   "monoraphid",
                                   "bv_5",
                                   "bv_5_10",
                                   "bv_10_20")) %>%
  # Ensure that all variables are considered as numerical
  mutate(across(everything(), ~as.numeric(as.character(.x))))

# Compute the abundance matrix
com_trait_estim_CWM <- rowSums(mpbc_m2,na.rm = TRUE) * CWM_tot
rownames(com_trait_estim_CWM) <- rownames(mpbc_m2)

# Check that the sum of abundances for each trait is equal to the total abundance of the sites

trait_list <- data.frame(modality= colnames(all_fuzzy)) %>% 
  mutate(trait = c(
    rep("shape", 7), #shape
    rep("living habit", 5), #living habit
    rep("sociability", 6), #sociability
    rep("raphe", 3), #raphe
    rep("attachment", 4),
    rep("biovolume", 3)#attachment
  ))

check_CWM <- com_trait_estim_CWM %>%
  rownames_to_column("id") %>%
  tidyr::gather(modality, value,-id) %>%
  left_join(., trait_list) %>%
  group_by(id,trait) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(value,na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  left_join(., data.frame(id=rownames(mpbc_m2),tot=rowSums(mpbc_m2))) %>%
  mutate(match_init = near(value,tot, tol = 1e-5))

all(check_CWM$match_init)
```

### PCA
```{r}
pcacwm <- rda(decostand(com_trait_estim_CWM, method = "hellinger"))
screeplot(pcacwm, bstick = TRUE)

site_scores2 <- cbind(as.data.frame(scores(pcacwm,
                                     scaling= 2,
                                     display="sites",
                                     choices=c(1,2))),
                      mpbc_site)

sp_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(pcacwm,scaling = 2,
                                  display="species",
                                  choices=c(1,2)))
ggplot()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
               linetype = 2) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
               linetype = 2) +
  geom_point(data =site_scores2,
             aes(x = PC1,
                 y = PC2,
                 colour = site))+
  geom_segment(data = sp_scores,
                 aes(x = 0,
                     y = 0,
                     xend = PC1,
                     yend = PC2),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.30, "cm")))+
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = sp_scores |> 
                               mutate(labels = rownames(sp_scores),
                                      labels = str_replace_all(labels,
                                                           "\\.",
                                                           " "),
                                      labels = case_match(labels,
                                                          "bv_5" ~ "\u003C3000 \u00B5m\u00B3",
                                                          "bv_5_10" ~ "3000–15000 \u00B5m\u00B3",
                                                          "bv_10_20" ~ "\u003E15000 \u00B5m\u00B3",
                                                          .default = labels)
                                      ),
                             aes(x = PC1,
                                 y = PC2,
                                 label = labels),
                             seed = 1,
                             inherit.aes = FALSE)+
  theme_light()+
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        legend.position=c(.85,.1),
        legend.background = element_blank())+
      scale_colour_manual(values = c("#5F8FB8", "#C45C7A"))q
```
